authority: Independent review brief only; no implementation inspected

assumptions.returns: Semantic result labels, not undocumented API return types.
assumptions.session_expiry: Valid iff request_time < activity+86400000; refresh checks actual apply-time expiry.
assumptions.authorization_snapshot: Previously authorized request may finish; explicitly required for logout and chosen for expiry.
assumptions.response_coordinate: Primary segment sequence; explicit scalar and byte projections supplied. Contract does not specify API coordinate.
assumptions.metadata_update: Fixture patches replace the supplied metadata field; metadata merge depth is not specified by the brief.
assumptions.pending_prompt_order: Insertion order chosen when more than one remains; each two-prompt race leaves at most one.
assumptions.finalized_at_null: Null does not count as a timestamp; malformed timestamp types not specified.
assumptions.terminal_pending: Terminal candidates in fixtures explicitly clear prompts; unconditional terminal clearing is not inferred.
assumptions.phase_value: Timestamp and receipt supplied together in these fixtures; partial per-field updates are separately discussed in Markdown.
assumptions.done: [DONE] chosen as the concrete sentinel; change encoding only if actual protocol declares a different spelling.
assumptions.framing: Unterminated EOF, malformed UTF-8, BOM, and bare fields omitted: not fully specified.
assumptions.redis_prefix: Exact uppercase initial token delimited by ASCII space or end of decoded message.
assumptions.public_address: Exclude listed special ranges; public unicast means address class rather than proving no anycast routing.

jobs.prompt_selection_assumption: first remaining request in insertion order
